title: OL-20261115-16: workers#166 Second installation on an account that is not the reference account
body:
**Owner:** ROWAN (identity-bound)
**Trigger:** second account door
**Done check:** file:org/second-installation.json
**Status:** closed

Moved from ultrastable/workers#166. IDENTITY-BOUND: sign in to a different Cloudflare or Google Cloud account and give the system a door. Same-account install is proven (workers#165, org/second-installation-live.json). Default in effect: the reference account keeps running.

**Disposition:** gate (owner-bound, 2026-11-20T20:46:50Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** owner field 'ROWAN (identity-bound)' binds this to the owner's own account, money or signature, which no server-side loop holds. Default in effect: the system runs without this step; nothing waits on it. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes.
